u0: Initial/unsatisfied state: no siren-switch success has been recorded, the siren is currently silent, and the switch has not yet been toggled in this state machine. Keep the exit option open: reaching the exit while the siren stays silent and no toggle occurs on that step goes directly to final u4. If the siren starts without a simultaneous toggle, the next state is u1, where you must toggle the wall switch. A toggle on the same step as a siren start moves directly to u3 with partial reward, while a silent toggle before any siren start moves to u2. The box, if present, is not tracked by this RM.
u1: Siren-response state: the siren has started and is currently ringing; no switch toggle has answered it yet. The immediate objective is to reach the wall switch, face it, and toggle; toggling here moves to u3 with partial reward. Do not finish at the exit before this toggle, because u1 has no exit transition to the final state. Box carrying or loss is irrelevant to this RM.
u2: Preemptive-toggle state: the switch has already been toggled while the siren was silent. The RM has no further switch requirement, so continue toward the exit. If the siren starts before the exit, this state moves to u3 with partial reward because the earlier toggle satisfies the before-or-after condition; after that, still head to the exit. If the siren never starts, reaching the exit goes directly to final u4 with reward 1. If neither occurs, remain in u2.
u3: Satisfied state: the switch has been toggled in connection with a siren start, either before or after it, so the conditional siren requirement is fulfilled and partial reward 0.2 has been collected. The only remaining objective is to reach the exit; doing so transitions to terminal u4 with reward 1. No further toggles or siren handling are required by this RM, and box status does not affect it.
u4: Terminal final state: the agent has reached the exit under an RM-accepted condition and the episode is complete. There is no further objective; actions produce no additional RM progress, and this absorbing final state persists.
